question: A wave used in radio broadcasting has wavelength $150\text{ m}$ in vacuum. Calculate its frequency and identify the region of the electromagnetic spectrum.

options.A:
$\nu=\dfrac{c}{\lambda}=\dfrac{3.0\times10^8}{150}=2.0\times10^{10}\text{ Hz}$.
It belongs to the microwave region.
options.B:
$\nu=\dfrac{\lambda}{c}=5.0\times10^{-7}\text{ Hz}$.
It belongs to the infrared region.
options.C:
$\nu=\dfrac{c}{\lambda}=\dfrac{3.0\times10^8}{150}=2.0\times10^6\text{ Hz}$.
It belongs to the radio-wave region.
options.D:
$\nu=2.0\times10^6\text{ Hz}$.
It belongs to the gamma-ray region.
